milestones.title: Property acquired
milestones.text: Official property acquisition and initial topographical survey walk.

milestones.title: Land clearing
milestones.text: Land clearing and physical boundary demarcation.

milestones.title: Irrigation delivery
milestones.text: Delivery of irrigation pipes and water management equipment.

milestones.title: Land tillage
milestones.text: Heavy land tillage and primary bed preparation.

milestones.title: Vehicle accident
milestones.text: Minor vehicle accident involving the blue Hilux near Crossroads Mall during commute.

milestones.title: KRC meeting
milestones.text: KRC meeting on crop selection, livestock locations, and manager roles.

milestones.title: New crew member
milestones.text: John Shabwande joined the farm crew.

milestones.title: Planting begins
milestones.text: Bed preparations finalized; planting initiated for summer crops (okra, green beans, carrots, and onions).

milestones.title: Daily operations
milestones.text: Daily farm operations focusing on routine watering, weeding, and growth monitoring.

milestones.title: Borehole pipe extended
milestones.text: Successful extension of the main borehole pipe to secure a reliable water supply.

milestones.title: Beds labeled
milestones.text: Physical labeling of all growing beds completed.

milestones.title: 103 chili beds
milestones.text: Finished constructing and preparing 103 chili beds.

milestones.title: Spraying: beans and okra
milestones.text: Green beans sprayed with Lara-max; okra sprayed with Cyper-max.

milestones.title: Lettuce harvest
milestones.text: Lettuce harvest half done / half in progress; sold first self-produced sample of 20 healthy lettuce heads.

execs.name: Dillon Nyimbili
execs.bio:
General Administrator - Responsible for overall coordination of farm trips - budget coordination, overseeing all farm departments.

Water supply manager - Responsible for coordinating water usage and storage, irrigation system installation and maintenance and training of the whole team on appropriate usage and management of water facilities.

execs.name: Davison Muzumara
execs.bio: Operations manager - Responsible for weekly and daily planning of target activities. Monitoring progress and improving daily output; i.e. coordinating all daily farm activities.

execs.name: Alichimfya Makangila
execs.bio: Crop Administrator - Responsible for creating, reviewing and sharing of crop growth calendars, schedules and expectations, including monitoring of crop growth and guidance for the team on crop requirements at various growth stages.

execs.name: Musonda Kaputo
execs.bio: Equipment manager - Responsible for monitoring and recording quantities and state of all equipment, ensuring good care and storage and coordinating purchasing, maintenance and replacement of all farm equipment.

execs.name: Ruth Beremauro
execs.bio: Human Resource Manager - Responsible for coordinating all staff(KRC officers and farm employees), team building, role assigning, facilitating training and conflict resolution. Responsible for reinforcing KRC vision, team motivation and attending to individual human resource concerns.

execs.name: Gibstar Makangila jr.
execs.role: Lead Systems Architect & Digital Project Director
execs.bio:
.Responsible for planning, building and maintaining KRC Farms' digital systems,  including extensive sustainable research
 the farm website and repository, its records, chronological timeline and photo storage,.  Ensures that information is organised, fact-based fact-checked vetted, secure and easy for the whole team to access.

execs.name: Betty-Ryan Makangila
execs.bio: Meeting Coordinator & Record Keeper - Responsible for scheduling and announcement of meetings, writing and sharing of minutes and coordinating weekly KRC meetings. Also responsible for keeping records of transactions and receipts for KRC-related expenses and purchases.
